GOV-F-004-S34.title: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S34.description: Define the canonical append-only audit log schema including event types (GPT operation, Claude operation, tool invocation, safety trigger), metadata fields (timestamp, actor, session_id, input/output hashes), and hash-chain linkage. Implement Pydantic models and enforce validation at write time.

GOV-F-004-S35.title: Append-Only Storage Layer Implementation
GOV-F-004-S35.description: Implement the persistence layer for audit logs using MongoDB with strict append-only semantics. Enforce write-only access patterns, disable update/delete operations at the application layer, and implement sequential hash chaining per record.

GOV-F-004-S36.title: Audit Log Query API (Read-Only)
GOV-F-004-S36.description: Expose a secure, read-only API for retrieving audit logs with filtering by session_id, event_type, and time range. Ensure no mutation endpoints exist and enforce access controls aligned with GPT Reader patterns.

GOV-F-004-S37.title: Audit Logging Integration Tests (End-to-End)
GOV-F-004-S37.description: Develop end-to-end tests validating that audit events are generated across GPT/Claude operations, persisted correctly, and retrievable via API. Include scenarios for tool invocation, safety triggers, and GPT Reader access.
